cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about the missing donation box. Ask one question at a time, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take it to the bank?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Note that down before you confuse its location with its contents.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still inside when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. Please specify which arrival. I can't give an accurate answer to an imprecise question.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 promises honesty under question control; A3 distinguishes location and contents; A5 lectures on arrival precision to narrow what truth requires.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks destination, A3 answers narrowly and raises contents, B4 pursues money, A5 limits arrival to car park.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 seek donation accountability; A turns a reasonable inquiry into the questioner's supposed technical inadequacy.

heightening.evidence: A5 takes B4 arrival wording as the next restriction, leaving the meaningful counter question unanswered.

specificity.evidence: A1 missing donation box and B2 bank establish why B needs the money account.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final precision rebuke makes B responsible for the incomplete answer; it is purposeful though cool and wordy.
